basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Penang. I love exploring new tech trends and am passionate about mental health advocacy. When I'm not coding, I enjoy gaming, watching political dramas like 'House of Cards', and engaging in discussions about cultural and societal issues. I'm single and typically browse Reddit during evenings and weekends after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in tech for over 5 years. My knowledge extends from software development to understanding the impact of technology on mental health, thanks to self-study and personal interest in psychology.
